command-descriptions.log: Log a string to the console.
command-descriptions.clearItems: Remove entities. Filtered by 'entity', 'object', item name or expie skin name.
command-descriptions.nukeSettings: Resets ALL data. Use as a last resort if the app malfunctions.
command-descriptions.resizeConsole: Resizes the terminal with the provided width and height in pixels.
command-descriptions.setMood: [Debug] Sets expies' moods. Might not work.
command-descriptions.spawn: Spawns an item. Only available items are 'crate' and 'sawblade'.
